decision: pass source-only review of isolated join v2, subject to required hosted compilation and tests
assessment: Cancellation while the join is pending drops the future and mutex guard while preserving the owned Running handle; when it returns Ready, the same poll records Succeeded or Failed before releasing the mutex.

The JoinError and possible arbitrary panic payload are dropped only after the terminal outcome is stored and the mutex released. A payload destructor panic can still propagate to its first shutdown caller, while subsequent callers see Failed and return Actor.

Five source-only controls use synthetic gated blocking tasks; their phase witnesses and sender-drop cleanup are explicit. Four expected baseline failures and one baseline success are predictions, not observed outcomes.
limits: No Cargo, Rust compilation, Clippy, rustdoc, Rust/native tests, WAL, network, benchmark, hosted run or root edits; the author reports source-only rustfmt success.
Tests do not exercise the real controller actor, WAL or transport. Actor wake/stop behavior and the separately blocked ControllerHandler byte-budget redesign are not changed or qualified.
Panic injection requires unwind; panic=abort terminates the process. A panic payload destructor can itself panic, reenter, block or abort; no blanket recovery guarantee.
No production readiness, release readiness or performance conclusion.
